content: {"charges": [{"claim": "The change makes normalizeUrl incorrectly treat a non-array options.removeDirectoryIndex with a length property as truthy, causing premature directory-index removal.", "file": "index.js", "line": 192, "severity": "major", "witnessCode": "import { describe, it } from 'node:test'\\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict'\\nimport normalizeUrl from '../index.js'\\n\\ndescribe('normalizeUrl removeDirectoryIndex bug', () => {\\n  it('should not remove directory index when options.removeDirectoryIndex is array-like object', () => {\\n    const input = 'http://example.com/index.html'\\n    const opts = {\\n      removeDirectoryIndex: {\\n        '0': /^index\\\\.[a-z]+$/,\\n        length: 1,\\n        some: Array.prototype.some\\n      }\\n    }\\n    const expected = 'http://example.com/index.html'\\n    assert.strictEqual(normalizeUrl(input, opts), expected)\\n  })\\n})"}]}
